name: AccuWeb Hosting
summary: Hosting provider for Linux and Windows VPS, Forex VPS, one-click application servers and dedicated servers in more than 20 locations, with 24/7 support.
best_for: developers and small businesses that want a cheap Linux or Windows VPS, or a dedicated server in a specific region, and will compare hosts on the renewal price
skip_if: you want a managed website host where someone else runs the server for you, or you only look at the first-term price and do not plan to move after two years
honest_knock: The plan prices are introductory rates on a 24-month term and renew at about two to four times as much: VPS Edge goes from €4.42 to €8.91 a month, VPS Power from €8.88 to €35.68. The money-back guarantee is 7 days, shorter than many hosts offer, and the prices shown change with your location and currency. The support response figures and customer numbers on the site are AccuWeb's own claims. We have not used AccuWeb Hosting ourselves.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on accuwebhosting.com/pricing/vps-hosting in a browser render from a Netherlands connection, which showed euros, with the 24-month term and the New York location selected) Four Linux VPS plans. VPS Edge is €4.42 a month and renews at €8.91: 4 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 50 GB storage, 250 GB bandwidth, 1 IP. VPS Peak, marked Most Popular, is €6.20 and renews at €17.83: 8 GB RAM, 2 vCPU, 100 GB, 450 GB bandwidth. VPS Power is €8.88 and renews at €35.68: 16 GB RAM, 3 vCPU, 200 GB, 650 GB bandwidth. VPS Supreme is €17.80 and renews at €71.36: 32 GB RAM, 4 vCPU, 400 GB, 1,000 GB bandwidth. The page advertises savings of 69% to 84% on these introductory prices, a 7-day money-back guarantee, 24/7 support and a 99.9% uptime guarantee. The home page, in US dollars, lists VPS hosting from $4.95 a month, Windows VPS from $6.33, Enterprise WordPress Cloud from $6.99, and dedicated servers from $103.00 a month in the USA and $149.00 in Frankfurt or Singapore, with a 99.99% uptime SLA on dedicated servers.

compare_with.name: Hostinger
compare_with.why: Hostinger is in our dossiers too and also sells low introductory VPS prices on long terms. AccuWeb prints its renewal price under every plan card and adds Windows VPS, Forex VPS and dedicated servers in more than 20 locations; compare both on the renewal price for the RAM and CPU you need, not on the first-term rate.
